capabilities: Pick a date from a calendar popup and rewrite it in its original format
Pick a time from a clock dial with hour, minute, and second hands
Type dates in plain words or shorthand via @ suggestions
Step date or time parts under the cursor with Ctrl/Option plus arrow keys
Configure built-in and custom date and time formats and which note sections to scan
disambiguation: Not a calendar view of your notes; it edits individual dates and times in place.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Reading mode is unsupported by design; frontmatter scanning is off by default because Obsidian has its own date picker for properties.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to change a date or time in note text without retyping it or to insert dates from natural-language phrases.

relations.evidence: Click a Tasks plugin emoji in front of a date

summary: Date and time editor that rewrites dates and times already in a note via a calendar, a clock dial, arrow-key stepping, or plain-word typing.
